It is an offense to maintain premises without a permit under this by-law or to violate any of the provisions of the
by-law and after being convicted by a court of competent jurisdiction for such offense, 122 of the Pradeshiya
Sabha  Act  No.  15  of  1987  (2)  Subject  to  a  fine  referred  to  in  subsection  (2).  When  a  person  who  has  been
convicted of an offense continues to violate or violate the offense by a court of competent jurisdiction over such
offense, a written notice shall be delivered by the Chairman, the Medical Officer of Health or the Public Health
Inspector  with  a  view  to  such  violation.  Each  subsequent  day  the  violation  continues  For  this  purpose  an
